title: went to a play in a random nyc apartment where they give you cocktail...
transcript: I'm about to go to someone's apartment to see a play do I know this person? no it's called Last Call a play with cocktails it's written by Hansel Young who wrote Wolf Play and Marry Me and Wild Goose Dreams and it's being performed all over the city at private residences I'm going alone so you have to come with me I'm going to see it in Fort Greene cause that's closest to my apartment and I got the address yesterday not gonna share it cause again it is someone's house this is truly all I know about it and yes you will get cocktails or mocktails if you don't drink okay I do see a line of people so I am at the right place oh hello this is so fun and wild I had the best time at that trying to figure out how to describe it so bear with me but the government is like in lockdown and everything is bad people are hosting these like underground parties just to like be free for a little bit you know so this bartender comes and he makes drinks and he tells stories and he makes the world feel a little less dark for a little bit but then you kind of start to get his backstory I don't really wanna spoil anything but it is about grief and truth and it's a really interesting social experiment I would say it's immersive semi immersive so what's really cool about it is they have like a rotating cast I had Chris Bannow and Mitchell Winter but they have men women non binary folks like all rotating in the stories what’s important but not the gender of the actor so I love they can do that I was also told some of the stories in the show change so if you go more than once you get like different drinks and different stories and now I'm sad cause I wanna go again and there are lots of opportunities to have drinks but they do have mocktails Hansol was there and I should have said hi but I was way too shy cause I just I love her work so much one day I will learn not to be a baby and go talk to people that I admire we were told at the end of the show that it does say sold out online but to keep an eye out because tickets have been popping up highly highly recommend if you get a chance it was an incredibly cool experience thank you for being my date tonight I love New York
